|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 4) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Wild Karrde (ALT) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V3-L-wildkarrde_ai-2021-02-18.png]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''Errata mark:''' the first image of this Alternate Image card already prints “E”: the mark follows the errata count of the card's text (the regular card had been errata'd before this image was made), but this image is the first version of the Alternate Image card. Recorded as printed and listed with the [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription errors]] (marks that do not match the version).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 18 February 2021<ref name="img-wildkarrde_ai91ca80c">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/wildkarrde_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 commit 91ca80c] (18 February 2021); the PC no longer serves it (the next day the PC moved this PNG to the repository's “hires” folder and published a GIF made from it). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “Medium Bulk Freighter”. Text: “May add 3 pilots and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During battle, your total battle destiny is +1 for each smuggler aboard. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. Immune to attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Wild Karrde (ALT) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 19 February 2021<ref name="img-wildkarrde_ai3f533fb">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/wildkarrde_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3f533fb998049f07503e71ef72b1853837190622 commit 3f533fb] (19 February 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/wildkarrde_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the PC replaced its high-resolution PNG upload of the day before with the GIF made from it for Holotable (the PNG was moved to the “hires” folder); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (703×980 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “Medium Bulk Freighter”. Text: “May add 3 pilots and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During battle, your total battle destiny is +1 for each smuggler aboard. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. Immune to attrition < 5.”
